description: This Java class 'CalculatedFieldDataValidator' extends 'DataValidator' to perform validation logic for 'CalculatedField' objects, including argument limits, configuration validation, scheduling, relation query arguments, and aggregation configurations within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for 'CalculatedField' objects, implementing various validation checks for configuration, arguments, scheduling, relation sources, and aggregation settings.

methods.name: validateDataImpl
methods.description: Performs core validation on 'CalculatedField' including argument count, configuration, scheduling, relation arguments, and aggregation.

methods.name: validateCreate
methods.description: Validates creation constraints for 'CalculatedField', including per-entity limits.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates update operation, ensuring the existing 'CalculatedField' exists.

methods.name: validateNumberOfArgumentsPerCF
methods.description: Checks if the number of arguments in 'ArgumentsBasedCalculatedFieldConfiguration' exceeds limits.

methods.name: validateSchedulingConfiguration
methods.description: Validates scheduling settings if enabled, against tenant profile limits.

methods.name: validateRelationQuerySourceArguments
methods.description: Validates relation query source arguments within the configuration.

methods.name: validateRelatedAggregationConfiguration
methods.description: Validates related entities aggregation configuration, especially deduplication interval.

methods.name: validateEntityAggregationConfiguration
methods.description: Validates entity aggregation interval against tenant profile limits.

methods.name: wrapAsDataValidation
methods.description: Utility to wrap validation logic and convert IllegalArgumentException to DataValidationException.
